description: List the synthetic audiences (simulated personas) in this workspace: their overall shape (where they are, what they do, how much is actually filled in) plus a sample with ids. These are simulated personas, not real people, and a stored persona pool is usually narrower than the audience a decision is about — read the distribution before targeting by id, and prefer describing the audience you want in aetherya_plan_study when the pool does not match it.
name: aetherya_list_audiences
title: List your synthetic audiences
